verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents its own bulk operations: batch categorization of transactions, uploading a batch of manual journal entries at once via a CSV template, and bulk adding or editing the Chart of Accounts by CSV upload. Missing for 10: batch categorization is evidenced only by a help-article title with no detail, no evidence that bulk actions can be driven through the API, MCP or AI agents, and no independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Instead of adding them one by one, you can upload a batch of entries all at once using Puzzle's CSV import template.
If you need to bulk add or edit your Chart of Accounts in Puzzle, you can do so by uploading a CSV file directly from your Company Settings.
